title: Continuity and boundedness of Ext
statement:
1. For $C\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$, the functors
   $\Hom_{D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)}(C,-[q])$ commute with filtered
   colimits of complexes with a common lower bound.
2. For each $C\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$ there is an integer $d_C$ such that
   $$
   \Ext^q_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}(C,N)=0
   \qquad\text{for all }q>d_C\text{ and all }N\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E).
   $$

proof.text: Fix $C\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and an integer $q$. Apply [det-lem-int-ext-continuity] to this $C$ and $q$: for every filtered diagram $(K_i)$ with a common lower bound, its statement gives the canonical isomorphism $\operatorname{colim}_i\Hom(C,K_i[q])\simeq\Hom(C,(\operatorname{colim}_iK_i)[q])$. This is assertion (1).

source.place: Assertion (1); sk-lem-int-ext.proof.md, continuity paragraph, as stated in existing det-lem-int-ext-continuity

proof.text: Fix $C\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$. The final sentence of [det-lem-int-ext-bound] supplies an integer $d_C$ such that $\Ext^q(C,N)=0$ for every $q>d_C$ and every $N\in\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$. Choose that integer. It depends on $C$ and is independent of $N$, exactly as required in assertion (2).
